thread:
zoe_support: FYI - customer reporting JSON parse failures after a routing fallback. They captured raw body; looks like we appended an observability envelope and a base64 blob which breaks their parser.

maria_customer: Customer details:
- endpoint: POST /v1/generate
- mode: structured/json
- model requested: best-l1
- error: JSONDecodeError: invalid character '<' at position 0

zoe_support: They included repro steps: curl POST with Accept: application/json, got 200 but parser throws. They can't change their parser quickly.

alex_runtime: Can we see the raw body they saved? Need the exact envelope format to decide fix.

maria_customer: Anonymized raw body (customer scrubbed IDs):
```
<REDWOOD-TRACE id=\"t-7c1e\">
route: smart-routing -> fallback quantized-v2
lat_ms: 104
</REDWOOD-TRACE>
{"items":[{"id":"sku_1","price":9.99}],"meta":{}}
--BLOB--: QmFzZTY0RW5jb2RlZFN0dWZm
```

maria_customer: Their decoder tries to json.loads() and fails because of the leading tag and trailing blob.

eng-runtime-bot: @alex_runtime looks like routing middleware emitted trace envelope after serialization. That code path should be skipped for application/json responses in structured mode.

alex_runtime: Agreed. Suspect tracing middleware runs post-serialization and just appends a debug block for tracing. We didn't gate it by content-type. That's the bug.

sre_jen: Customer is dedicated and wants a fix on our side. Short-term options:
- advise pinning variant to avoid fallback (not ideal)
- toggle smart-routing off for their org (annoying)
- hotfix middleware to not append traces/blobs for application/json responses

maria_customer: They prefer server-side change. Can't alter parser right now.

zoe_support: Could we add a temporary header we honor to strip envelopes (X-Redwood-Strip: true) so customer can retry immediately?

alex_runtime: I can ship a hotfix: guard the trace envelope append behind a check: if Content-Type == application/json OR mode == structured then skip. I'll open PR and run CI.

eng-runtime-bot: @alex_runtime opened PR #4876: middleware: avoid trace envelope when content-type application/json. CI triggered.

zoe_support: Customer asks for ETA and whether user data could have been leaked via traces.

alex_runtime: ETA ~60-90m to staging, then ~1-2h to production after smoke tests. Traces are per-request and don't reprocess payloads; they contain routing metadata only. We'll confirm no sensitive fields present and share request IDs for the window.

maria_customer: Also requested a list of request IDs for 1952509800-1952509950 to correlate.

sre_jen: I'll export request IDs and timestamps for that window after the fix is in; should be straightforward.

eng-runtime-bot: deploy for hotfix/4876 to prod completed at 1952510400

zoe_support: Patch deployed. @maria_customer can you ask the customer to retry and paste the raw body if it still fails?

maria_customer: Customer retried and reports: "parser ok now, no leading tag or blob. Thanks." They asked we add a follow-up sanitizer to drop any non-json prefix/suffix when mode=json in case of future regressions.

alex_runtime: Will add a unit test asserting structured/json responses cannot contain trace envelopes or appended blobs and follow-up with a server-side sanitizer as a defense-in-depth. Assigning the test to myself.

zoe_support: Closing the support ticket once SRE confirms export delivered. Will monitor smart-routing telemetry for anomalies. :thumbsup:

maria_customer: Thanks team, customer satisfied.

eng-runtime-bot: Note: follow-up task created: INFR-2201 add sanitizer for JSON-mode responses.
